launches.title: Oki AI - Personalized Updates on Company Progress
launches.tagline: All the context you need to run your company, delivered daily.
launches.body:
Hey! 👋 Luofei and Aayush here from [**Oki**](https://www.okiapplications.com/).

**TL;DR**

Oki reads your team’s code, tickets, docs, and messages, then drops a personalized, interactive update to you every morning. You start the day knowing exactly what’s shipping, slipping, or on fire - no digging required.

https://youtu.be/gEc8SP4SmaQ

\
**Problem:**

As a startup grows, the once-lean, founder-led culture slows down: information scatters, teams bloat, and leaders lose line-of-sight on what’s really happening. **Decisions suffer because the right context no longer finds its way to the right people.**

In an ideal world, you wake up to all the context you need.

[**For our customers, Oki AI is that ideal world.**](https://www.okiapplications.com/)

Connect your apps once, and Oki sends a personalized report daily to every leader at your company. And it’s not just an email; Oki allows you to dig into sources, timelines, and teams, ensuring you always have full context to make every decision.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92002&key=user_uploads/341385/4ef26d26-4622-47b0-a836-29722bc9ca46)

\
🚀 **Get your first Oki report today.**

[**Oki AI**](https://www.okiapplications.com/) is fully self serve and only takes 5 minutes to set up.

launches.title: Oki AI - Automated Project Tracking for Engineering Leaders
launches.tagline: AI Insights to automate project tracking and Boost Eng Productivity
launches.body:
Hey everyone! Luofei and Aayush here from Oki.

**TL;DR**\
Oki unifies data from Slack, GitHub, Jira, and more into one AI-powered dashboard, so Engineering leaders can automatically track progress, better allocate resources, and boost org productivity. No more endless hunts for ground truth or time-consuming status updates!

**Demo**\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zUKDdNCNeK0>

**The Problem**\
CTOs, VPs, and Directors of Engineering can’t truly see what’s happening across their teams. Even with teams of direct reports and countless status meetings, updates get missed, priorities shift, and some projects get overlooked. There’s too much context for any one person to track, leading to incomplete or inaccurate reporting.

**The Solution**\
Oki aggregates all your project data - no setup or manual input required - and surfaces behind-schedule items, emerging blockers, and under-resourced teams. You can drill down into any issue to see exactly what’s happening, so instead of spending meeting time asking, “What’s the status?” you can focus on, “How do we fix it?”

**Our Ask**

* If you’d like to use Oki right away - we’d love to chat! Here’s our email: [founders@okiapplications.com](mailto:founders@okiapplications.com)
* If you know someone who’d love to use Oki, we would greatly appreciate an intro!
* Chat with us about anything at [luofei@okiapplications.com](mailto:luofei@okiapplications.com), [aayush@okiapplications.com](mailto:aayush@okiapplications.com) - we’d love any feedback too!
